texts:
Here's a list of countries with their heads of state and heads of government in 1980:

1. Afghanistan 
   - Head of State: Mohammad Daoud Khan
   - Head of Government: Hafizullah Amin

2. Albania 
   - Head of State: Ramiz Alia
   - Head of Government: Adil Çarçani

3. Algeria 
   - Head of State: Chadli Bendjedid
   - Head of Government: Muhammad Benyahia (Note: Chadli Bendjedid became the head of government in 1980 but I listed the head of government of the time who was in power the most part of 1980)

4. Andorra 
   - Head of State: Joan Martí Alomar and Joan Antoni Duran i Linares (Co-Princes)
   - Head of Government: Josep Pintat-Solans

5. Angola 
   - Head of State: Agostinho Neto
   - Head of Government: Lopo do Nascimento

6. Antigua and Barbuda 
   - Head of State: Elizabeth II
   - Head of Government: Vere Bird

7. Argentina 
   - Head of State: Jorge Videla
   - Head of Government: Roberto Viola

8. Australia 
   - Head of State: Elizabeth II
   - Head of Government: Malcolm Fraser

9. Austria 
   - Head of State: Rudolf Kirchschläger
   - Head of Government: Bruno Kreisky

10. Bahamas 
   - Head of State: Elizabeth II
   - Head of Government: Lynden Pindling

11. Bahrain 
   - Head of State: Isa bin Salman Al Khalifa
   - Head of Government: Khalifa bin Salman Al Khalifa

12. Bangladesh 
   - Head of State: Ziaur Rahman
   - Head of Government: Shah Azizur Rahman

13. Barbados 
   - Head of State: Elizabeth II
   - Head of Government: Errol Barrow

14. Belgium 
   - Head of State: Baudouin
   - Head of Government: Willy De Clercq

15. Belize 
   - Head of State: Elizabeth II
   - Head of Government: George Cadle Price

16. Benin 
   - Head of State: Mathieu Kérékou
   - Head of Government: Mathieu Kérékou

17. Bhutan 
   - Head of State: Jigme Singye Wangchuck
   - Head of Government: Jigme Singye Wangchuck

18. Bolivia 
   - Head of State: David Padilla
   - Head of Government: Walter Guevara Arze

19. Botswana 
   - Head of State: Seretse Khama Ian Khama
   - Head of Government: Quett Masire

20. Brazil 
   - Head of State: João Figueiredo
   - Head of Government: João Figueiredo

21. Brunei 
   - Head of State: Hassanal Bolkiah
   - Head of Government: Hassanal Bolkiah

22. Bulgaria 
   - Head of State: Todor Zhivkov
   - Head of Government: Georgi Atanasov

23. Burma (Myanmar) 
   - Head of State: Ne Win
   - Head of Government: Sein Win

24. Burundi 
   - Head of State: Jean-Baptiste Bagaza
   - Head of Government: Léopold Biha

25. Cameroon 
   - Head of State: Paul Biya
   - Head of Government: Paul Biya

26. Canada 
   - Head of State: Elizabeth II
   - Head of Government: Pierre Trudeau

27. Central African Republic 
   - Head of State: André Kolingba
   - Head of Government: Ange-Sélection Secadin

28. Chad 
   - Head of State: Goukouni Oueddei
   - Head of Government: Hissène Habré (as prime minister of transition)

29. Chile 
   - Head of State: Augusto Pinochet
   - Head of Government: José García

30. China 
   - Head of State: Deng Xiaoping
   - Head of Government: Hua Guofeng

31. Colombia 
   - Head of State: Julio César Turbay Ayala
   - Head of Government: Julio César Turbay Ayala

32. Comoros 
   - Head of State: Ahmed Abdallah
   - Head of Government: Ahmed Abdallah

33. Costa Rica 
   - Head of State: Rodrigo Carazo
   - Head of Government: Rodrigo Carazo

34. Côte d'Ivoire 
   - Head of State: Félix Houphouët-Boigny

1. United States
   - Head of State: Jimmy Carter
   - Head of Government: Jimmy Carter

2. Soviet Union
   - Head of State: Leonid Brezhnev
   - Head of Government: Alexei Kosygin (until October 1980), Nikolai Tikhonov (from October 1980)

3. United Kingdom
   - Head of State: Queen Elizabeth II
   - Head of Government: Margaret Thatcher

4. France
   - Head of State: Valéry Giscard d'Estaing
   - Head of Government: Raymond Barre

5. Germany (West)
   - Head of State: Karl Carstens
   - Head of Government: Helmut Schmidt

6. Germany (East)
   - Head of State: Erich Honecker
   - Head of Government: Willi Stoph

7. China
   - Head of State: Ye Jianying (until September 1980), Li Xiannian (from September 1980)
   - Head of Government: Hua Guofeng (until September 1980), Zhao Ziyang (from September 1980)

8. Japan
   - Head of State: Emperor Hirohito
   - Head of Government: Masayoshi Ohira (until June 1980), Zenko Suzuki (from June 1980)

9. India
   - Head of State: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy
   - Head of Government: Charan Singh (until January 1980), Indira Gandhi (from January 1980)

10. Pakistan
    - Head of State: Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq
    - Head of Government: Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq

11. Egypt
    - Head of State: Anwar Sadat
    - Head of Government: Anwar Sadat

12. Iran
    - Head of State: Ruhollah Khomeini
    - Head of Government: Mehdi Bazargan (until November 1980), Mohammad-Ali Rajai (from November 1980)

13. Iraq
    - Head of State: Saddam Hussein
    - Head of Government: Saddam Hussein

14. Israel
    - Head of State: Yitzhak Navon
    - Head of Government: Menachem Begin

15. Canada
    - Head of State: Queen Elizabeth II (represented by Governor General Edward Schreyer)
    - Head of Government: Pierre Trudeau

16. Australia
    - Head of State: Queen Elizabeth II (represented by Governor-General Zelman Cowen)
    - Head of Government: Malcolm Fraser

17. South Africa
    - Head of State: Marais Viljoen
    - Head of Government: Pieter Willem Botha

18. Brazil
    - Head of State: João Figueiredo
    - Head of Government: João Figueiredo

19. Argentina
    - Head of State: Jorge Videla (until March 1981)
    - Head of Government: Jorge Videla (until March 1981)

20. Mexico
    - Head of State: José López Portillo
    - Head of Government: José López Portillo

1. United States: President - Jimmy Carter, Vice President - Walter Mondale, Secretary of State - Edmund Muskie (initially), then Cyrus Vance, and then Edmund Muskie again.
2. United Kingdom: Queen - Queen Elizabeth II, Prime Minister - Margaret Thatcher
3. Soviet Union: General Secretary - Leonid Brezhnev
4. China: Paramount Leader - Deng Xiaoping, Chairman of the People's Republic of China - Yang Shangkun
5. Germany (West): Chancellor - Helmut Schmidt
6. Germany (East): General Secretary of the Central Committee of the SED - Erich Honecker
7. France: President - Valéry Giscard d'Estaing, Prime Minister - Raymond Barre
8. Japan: Emperor - Hirohito, Prime Minister - Masayoshi Ōhira
9. Canada: Queen - Queen Elizabeth II, Prime Minister - Pierre Trudeau
10. India: President - Neelam Sanjiva Reddy, Prime Minister - Morarji Desai
11. Italy: President - Sandro Pertini, Prime Minister - Aldo Moro (until May 1978), afterwards Arnaldo Forlani (from June 1978), then Giovanni Spadolini (from March 1979)
12. Australia: Queen - Queen Elizabeth II, Prime Minister - Malcolm Fraser
13. South Africa: State President - Marjorie F. Whitcher (acting), later P.W. Botha (as State President from September 1980)
14. Brazil: President - João Figueiredo
15. Mexico: President - José López Portillo
16. Russia: Supreme Soviet Chairman - Nikolai Tikhonov (acting), later Konstantin Chernenko
17. Spain: King - Juan Carlos I, Prime Minister - Adolfo Suárez (until May 1981), then Leopoldo Calvo-Sotelo (from July 1981)
18. Turkey: President - Kenan Evren, Prime Minister - Bülent Ulusu
19. Iran: Supreme Leader - Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, President - Abolhassan Banisadr (until June 1981), then Mohammad-Ali Rajai (from August 1981) and Mohammad-Ali Rajai is assassinated and Mohammad-Hassan Babol is acting, then Mohammad-Ali Rajai as PM again (from September 1981), until he is assassinated, then Mohammad-Javad Bahonar (from September 1981)
20. Poland: President - Wojciech Jaruzelski, First Secretary of the Communist Party of Poland - Edward Gierek (until October 1980), then Stanisław Kania (from October 1980)
21. Israel: President - Chaim Herzog, Prime Minister - Menachem Begin (until June 1981), then Menachem Begin and Yitzhak Shamir (national unity government) until July 1982, then Menachem Begin alone
22. South Korea: President - Chun Doo-hwan
23. Indonesia: President - Suharto
24. Argentina: President and Chief of the Armed Forces (junta) - General Roberto Viola (until December 1981), then General Reynaldo Bignone (from December 1981)
25. Nigeria: President - Shehu Shagari, Head of State - General Muhammadu Buhari (from December 1983, coup)

1. Afghanistan - Head of State: Nur Muhammad Taraki, Head of Government: Hafizullah Amin
2. Albania - Head of State: Enver Hoxha, Head of Government: Shehu Shaban Dhino
3. Algeria - Head of State: Houari Boumediene, Head of Government: Mohamed Boudiaf
4. Andorra - Head of State: Henri de Bourbon-Parme (Representative), Head of Government: Josep M. Pla
5. Angola - Head of State: Agostinho Neto, Head of Government: Agostinho Neto
6. Argentina - Head of State and Head of Government: Leopoldo Fortunato Galtieri
7. Armenia - Not independent (part of the Soviet Union)
8. Australia - Head of State: Queen Elizabeth II (represented by Governor-General Sir Ninian Stephen), Head of Government: Malcolm Fraser
9. Austria - Head of State: President Kurt Waldheim, Head of Government: Bruno Kreisky
10. Azerbaijan - Not independent (part of the Soviet Union)
